title: Dirt Loot
description:
Adds dirt tools, dirt armor, and simple achievements to Minecraft.
Craft everything using just dirt and wheat seeds for an easy early-game option or a fun challenge.
body:
![Dirty Loot..](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebe17f3713e7f62ef91a0323598c1f391625b668_0.webp)This mod includes:

2 achievements

5 dirt tools

A full armor set made from pure dirt

Crafting is super simple — all you need is dirt and wheat seeds.
Perfect for early game survival, challenges, or just messing around.
